title: Reports - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Reports - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: Lady Irwin College in Delhi is a constituent college of the University of Delhi that offers academic programs and services to students. The college is accredited with an A+ grade by NAAC and holds a National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) position of 31. Its website provides essential information such as address, contacts, and quick links for students, along with operational hours from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm. Admission enquiries can be made through the site, and the page is powered by WhiteCode. The college’s online presence highlights its academic credentials and accessibility for prospective and current students.
key_points: Lady Irwin College is part of the University of Delhi.
The college has received an A+ accreditation from NAAC.
It is ranked 31st in the NIRF rankings.
College hours are scheduled from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm.
The website offers address and contact details for visitors.
Quick links for students and an admission enquiry form are available on the site.
